answer: Require every new agent to enter through a single verified inlet: a sponsor holding a staked deposit must vouch for it, and that stake is slashed if the agent misbehaves. One operator cannot forge a thousand credible sponsors, because each sponsorship costs real stake and reputation that compounds with every bad referral. Honest agents build a crystal record of completed work, so trust accrues to proven identities while cheap throwaway accounts stay at zero - attack cost scales with each fake identity, honest value with history.
